name: InboxGeek LiveLeads
author: PAC Digital

sections.description:
InboxGeek helps you to turn your anonymous website visitors into paying customers. Maximise your advertising ROI by capturing the contact information of website visitors don’t convert today.

Features

Identify your anonymous website visitors use their email address to retarget or directly contact them. Close leads you never knew you had since 98% of visitors don’t make an enquiry. Take action on leads before your competitors. Increase your online ROI by getting more leads out of your site.

External services

This plugin connects to an external API run by InboxGeek.com (api.inboxgeek.com) to provide session tracking and identity resolution services.

It sends a unique session identifier and a source identifier each time the user views a page on the site.

This service is provided by “InboxGeek.com”: terms of use, privacy policy
sections.installation:
The easy way:

  1. Go to the Plugins Menu in WordPress
  2. Search for “InboxGeek”
  3. Click “Install”

Text Guide:

First login to your InboxGeek Portal then you will need to copy the LiveLeads source id (you can find this under LiveLeads -> Sources -> Actions -> Copy Script)

  • On your WordPress site go to Settings > InboxGeek LiveLeads [You can paste your source id there]
